overlap.comparison: The accepted equality lemma concerns one common direction attaining ordinary depth in each fiber and proves homothety of the captured caps. It does not assert whole endpoint homothety from a finite critical mixed cover.

Its homothety conclusion needs every canonical cap at an affine interior section to attain the special Grünbaum fraction on each fiber. The truncated-triangle example has different ambient cap offsets and equal raw trace areas, not those fiberwise normalized fractions.

readability: The positive dependence is confined to the middle continuous margins. The finite arithmetic certificate covers both orientations through one canonical normalized direction.
